title: harness-hub repository-level declaration (<repo root>/.harness.toml)
description: What a repository's own harness owns and the allow-listed guard overrides it sets (principle 8: user-level by design, repository-level wins). Readers parse a TOML subset: one statement per line, whole-line comments, no inline comments, escapes or multi-line arrays. `harness repo` validates against this schema.

harness.description: Where the repository's own harness is described (a path or URL).

owns.description: What the repository's own harness covers: every hub component in these domains, or with these ids, yields here.

domains.description: Taxonomy domains (docs/reference/taxonomy.md). `base` has no effect on the guard: the credential section never yields.

components.description: Component ids as `harness catalog` prints them (e.g. core/guard.d/30-git, ticket-workflow/skills/work-ticket).

overrides.description: Allow-listed WORK_TICKET_* guard settings (docs/reference/hook-policy.md#repo-overrides); client paths, credential settings and every other prefix are settable only from the developer's own environment. A variable of the same name in the real environment (a provider env override) wins.
